item.title: iPhone Handoff will seamlessly share one number between two phones
item.description: When iOS 27 lands later this month, it will have a feature called iPhone Handoff that lets you switch between two phones using the same number. It was briefly mentioned during the WWDC keynote back in June, but there were no details at the time. Now there's a demo clip showing how to set up […]

item.title: This new robot lawn mower comes with its own infrared hedgehog-spotter — and a handy approach to edge-trimming
item.description: The Anthbot R7 will reach out and hand-trim the edges of your lawn.

item.title: The reasons rugged laptops are rarely bought by consumers
item.description: There are plenty of durable, versatile rugged laptops on the market, but you'll rarely see one get pulled out at the coffee shop. Why?

item.title: Hikers rescued after using Google Gemini for planning
item.description: The sheriff’s office said the hikers “were advised by Gemini to bring far less food and water than their group required."
